title: DWG 3DFACE invisible-edge flag domain and retry
scope: Prevent DWG 3DFACE writer narrowing from silently changing invalid edge masks and verify bounded versioned output/readback.

authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

implementation.behavior: The DWG facade rejects base DRW_3Dface values below NoEdge or above AllEdges before entity encoding and latches the write failure, preserving derived custom codec behavior.

generatedControl.source: Locally authored at test runtime; output DWGs are written to scratch and removed.
generatedControl.geometry: One tilted planar WCS face, one flat zero-Z face, and one following LINE; readback compares all corner coordinates, masks, and LINE coordinates.
generatedControl.failureAndRetry: For every writer version, each invalid mask is rejected without changing the existing destination bytes; the same dwgRW and adapter then write a corrected drawing which is read back successfully.

validation.buildResult: PASS under the configured warning-as-error policy

evidenceCeiling: Generated writer/parser consistency and failure atomicity only. No independent producer, native application, or family-wide 3DFACE support claim is established. No DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
